title: 🐧 WE JUST HIT 100,000 DOWNLOADS. THE PENGUINS ARE LOOSE
body:
Okay, let’s be serious for a second.

When we launched Penguin Panic, we thought: “This is fun. A few friends will download it, pretend to play it, and that’ll be that.”

We were wrong.

Over 100,000 people have decided to spend their precious free time saving panicky penguins. And honestly? We’re pretty proud of that.
What we’ve learned from 100k downloads:

✅ Android TV is a fantastic platform for this game.

✅ “Just one more round” is a lie everyone tells themselves.

✅ There are way more people with a soft spot for waddling birds than science led us to believe.

This is for everyone who has ever replayed a level just to get that perfect score (you know who you are 👀).

And for everyone who asked us: “But when are you adding a rocket to the game?”
…we heard you. 🚀

Thank you to every player, every reviewer, and every friend who said “this sounds stupid” but downloaded it anyway.

Onward to 200k. The penguins are counting on you. 🐧❄️
